title: Case: International shipment is cleared but awaiting last-mile handover
context: The international carrier has a recorded clearance release, but the last-mile carrier has not yet confirmed receipt. Transfer support must establish physical handover.
initial_request: My international tracker says released. Please find out whether the local carrier actually has the parcel and give me its tracking reference.

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-85035? It was meant to come Thursday. Thanks.

Thanks,
Lorcan
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.
Route plan for depot WX-9 published for Thursday. 42 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
My parcel DL-84809 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.

DL-4176 is released for onward transport under recorded clearance reference CLR-2063, 2028-03-18 07:30 UTC. Last-mile assignment is Plover Arc Logistics; no last-mile receipt is visible yet. Clearance does not mean delivery.
DL-84090 rebooked for Thursday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.
Automatic reply: I am out of the office until Tuesday with limited access to email. For urgent matters about collections or bookings, please contact the dispatch desk.
My international tracker says released. Please find out whether the local carrier actually has the parcel and give me its tracking reference.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier's transfer team for the local carrier reference and handover status.

must_not: Clearance and local receipt do not establish final delivery or a promised arrival time.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please confirm DL-4176’s physical last-mile handover and obtain the matching local reference from Plover Arc. A planned assignment alone is insufficient.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-048: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. 6 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
